content: The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for the premixed insulin and GLP-1 receptor agonist product degludec/liraglutide is $991 per 1,000 units of the specified dosage form. In comparison, the median AWP for the premixed insulin and GLP-1 receptor agonist product glargine/lixisenatide is $679 per 1,000 units of the specified dosage form.
